<thought>Using the most intense peak at m/z 262.09938 and matching it to the monoisotopic mass of candidate formulas, the best fit is C₁₈H₁₄O₂ (exact mass 262.09938). This satisfies the isotopic pattern (≈18 carbons) and gives an integer DBE. Therefore the molecular formula is C18H14O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H14O2</final_answer>
